payload.claim: Criterion 3 is preserves:true and lists wrong_versions its witness must still catch, but refs/saffron/mutants does not exist on this base (confirmed), so the witness gate cannot machine-verify the preserved test actually kills those wrong versions -- it can only confirm the test still passes unmodified. The spec discloses this and suggests the operator could add a mutant with `saffron mutant`, so it is not hidden, but a person should decide before the cell starts whether to seed a mutant first or accept criterion 3's regression protection is asserted but not machine-checked this round.
